info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Assigns-v1-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment Retrieval API provides users with the ability to access and review the assignments of support tickets. This endpoint returns a list of tickets currently assigned to different support agents, streamlining the process of monitoring and managing support workloads. Typical consumers of this API include support managers and team leads who need insight into ticket assignments to optimize resource allocation. By providing a clear overview of assignments, the API helps enhance efficiency and accelerate the resolution of customer issues.

get.description: Fetches the list of tickets that have been assigned to users for processing or resolution.

requestBody.description: This endpoint is used to assign tickets to a user. It accepts a JSON payload that specifies the details of the assignment, such as the ticket ID and user ID. Ensure that the provided data conforms to the required schema.
